[SWS_CM_10491] Re-establishing service connection
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00102, RS_CM_00107
⌈
In case the service becomes temporarily unavailable (due to restart, network problem
or so), or if an error occurs while establishing a connection to the service and the
Communication Management shall retry to establish the connection once the next offer
is received.
⌋
